title: ==MANUAL TESTER — RETAIL · AIRLINE · TRAVEL · HOSPITALITY==

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Manual Test Engineer== with 6+ years of experience ==preparing and executing test plans, scenarios and scripts== across web, mobile and ==e-commerce== applications. ==Leads project-team QA activities==, acting as SME and QA sign-off authority, and ==coordinates with stakeholders through DSR/WSR, Scrum and client calls==. ==Hands-on with test management tools Jira and Azure DevOps==; working knowledge of test automation (Selenium WebDriver, BrowserStack LCNC, ACCELQ), ==API testing (Postman, REST Assured)==, and ==thorough knowledge of database validation== including ==ETL-style data reconciliation== across subscription, billing and CRM systems. ==Defines, monitors and reports on SLAs== for releases and production readiness, manages resources for on-time delivery, and mitigates software-quality risks at each phase of STLC.

sections.note: FILL-IN — the JD's gate is Retail/Airline/Travel/Hospitality domain experience. The resume shows e-commerce (retail-adjacent) but no airline/travel/hospitality: those are [placeholders]. If genuinely absent, this is a stretch — the honest angle is e-commerce + marketplace testing (retail), proven team-lead/SME experience, and data reconciliation. [ETL testing] also needs genuine evidence; the resume supports SQL-based data reconciliation, not ETL pipelines.

==Coordinate the work of junior QA engineers==, mentoring 2 juniors on testing activities, test-case reviews and defect validation.
